content.text:
Perfect! All 38 tests pass. I've added two functions to src/invoices.js:

**addLine(invoice, { sku, qty })** — adds a new line or increases qty if the SKU already exists, validates qty and SKU, returns NOT_DRAFT if invoice isn't draft

**removeLine(invoice, sku)** — removes a line by SKU, returns LINE_NOT_FOUND if SKU doesn't exist, NO_LINES if removing the last line, NOT_DRAFT if invoice isn't draft

Added error codes to src/errors.js:
- NOT_DRAFT
- LINE_NOT_FOUND

Tests cover all error cases, happy paths, and immutability.
